<!--
What you are trying to do, and what is in the way, is the request. The solution
you have in mind is useful context but not the ask -- there is usually more than
one way to unblock you, and the maintainer may have a reason for the current
design.

Before filing: check the open issues, since a rough version of this may already
be there and a comment saying so is faster than a duplicate.
-->

## The problem

<!-- The situation that made you file this. Who hits it, and how often. -->

## What you wanted to do instead

<!-- What you tried, or would have done, if the platform allowed it. -->

## Proposal

<!--
Optional. If you have something specific in mind, sketch it. Where it would live
in the code (a package under internal/, a screen under web/src/), what it would
change, and what it would cost.

If you are unsure, say so. An honest "I do not know where this fits" is a better
request than a confident design that misses the boundary you did not know was
there.
-->

## Alternatives you considered

<!--
Anything else you tried, including doing it outside openplan. A workaround
someone else can adopt is genuinely valuable, and worth documenting even if we
do not build the feature.
-->

## Scope

- [ ] Backend only (`cmd/`, `internal/`)
- [ ] Frontend only (`web/`)
- [ ] Both
- [ ] Infrastructure or deployment
- [ ] Documentation only
